what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In person at LMS Room D132, or via Zoom (link and meeting ID printed on the agenda); also broadcast later on local access cable and YouTube.
preview.hook: Business Administrator finalist interview, café contract ratification, a possible financial audit, and Town Meeting warrant articles
preview.one_line: School Committee, Wed 9/9 7pm hybrid: interviews a Business Administrator finalist, votes on Town Meeting warrant articles, ratifies the café contract, discusses a financial audit.

items.why_it_matters: The committee reviews and approves the district's outgoing payments for this period.

items.agenda_line: a. Public Interview of Business Administrator-Derrick Andrews (10 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee publicly interviews a candidate for the district's top financial/operations staff position.

items.agenda_line: Executive Session- to consider or interview applicants for employment or appointment by a preliminary screening committee.
items.why_it_matters: The committee meets privately to discuss job applicants, a step in filling a district position.
The committee discusses a grant that could bring outside funding to the district.

items.agenda_line: b. Donation-Girl Scouts Haddie’s Bench (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee considers accepting a donated bench for school grounds.

items.agenda_line: c. Back to School Updates-Principals (5 min)
items.why_it_matters: Principals give updates on the start of the school year.

items.agenda_line: d. Vote to Approve Warrant Articles 9/3/26 Town Meeting (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee votes on its position for Town Meeting warrant articles, which can affect town spending residents will vote on.
The committee formally ratifies a contract related to the school café, a service students use daily.
The committee discusses whether to pursue a financial audit of the district's books.
The committee discusses its own internal rules for how it operates.
The committee reviews its own goals and the past year.

items.agenda_line: a. FY26 Year End Budget review (5 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee reviews how the prior fiscal year's budget actually played out.

facebook:
School Committee meets Wednesday September 9 at 7:00pm.

Business Administrator finalist interview, café contract ratification, a possible financial audit, and Town Meeting warrant articles.

On the agenda: a. Warrants    7/28/26 to 8/27/26 $396,688.90; b. Donation-Girl Scouts Haddie’s Bench (3 min); d. Vote to Approve Warrant Articles 9/3/26 Town Meeting (3 min); e. Café Contract Ratification(3 min).

In person at LMS Room D132, or via Zoom (link and meeting ID printed on the agenda); also broadcast later on local access cable and YouTube.

Agenda: https://www.lunenburgma.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_09092026-8002
